subject: general
question: A snail moves 25 m South, then turns left and moves 125 m, then turns left and moves 10 m, again turns left and moves 75 m and lastly turns right and moves 15 m. Where is the snail now with reference to its starting position?
solution:
**Direction:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/babea32b2888e4a8ce02829a5946aefd50a9a90c7061d88ebfca01ce9e1d622b.png] 

According to the given conditions :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3d208c0612fb37dea185111b9b160d509f3cb10af0410add7521dedfa60bbf5.png] 

Snail is 125 - 75 = 50 m to the East with reference to its starting position.

Hence, 50 m East is the correct answer.
